description: GA holds g (1, 1, 1, 2, 2, Null, Null, Null, 3), h, v and d with Nulls. Which GROUP BY forms are accepted, with which rows and error numbers: an expression (v Mod 2) written in full and in parentheses, by output alias, by position 1, two keys with an expression, UCase, concatenation and IIf keys, a constant, 1 + 1 and Null as the key, a Boolean key, a select item that is not in the GROUP BY, an expression of a grouped column, a key repeated, and a grouped column absent from the select list? Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-13b-main (ACCDB) opened read-only through ACE DAO; each text is opened as a snapshot with Database.OpenRecordset, Fields Name/Type/Size are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.

args.text: SELECT v Mod 2 AS r, Count(*) AS n FROM GA GROUP BY v Mod 2
SELECT v Mod 2 AS r, Count(*) AS n FROM GA GROUP BY r
SELECT v Mod 2 AS r, Count(*) AS n FROM GA GROUP BY 1
SELECT v Mod 2 AS r, Count(*) AS n FROM GA GROUP BY (v Mod 2)
SELECT g, v Mod 2 AS r, Count(*) AS n FROM GA GROUP BY g, v Mod 2
SELECT UCase(h) AS u, Count(*) AS n FROM GA GROUP BY UCase(h)
SELECT g & '' AS s, Count(*) AS n FROM GA GROUP BY g & ''
SELECT IIf(v > 6, 'hi', 'lo') AS b, Count(*) AS n FROM GA GROUP BY IIf(v > 6, 'hi', 'lo')
SELECT Count(*) AS n FROM GA GROUP BY 'k'
SELECT Count(*) AS n FROM GA GROUP BY 1 + 1
SELECT Count(*) AS n FROM GA GROUP BY Null
SELECT v > 5 AS b, Count(*) AS n FROM GA GROUP BY v > 5
SELECT g, Count(*) AS n FROM GA GROUP BY g + 0
SELECT g + 0 AS q, Count(*) AS n FROM GA GROUP BY g
SELECT g, Count(*) AS n FROM GA GROUP BY g, g
SELECT Count(*) AS n FROM GA GROUP BY g
